findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 2
Case: normal use - a VPN or unreliable network silently drops connections to PyPI. `forge next` passes a three-second timeout to `_newest`, but [CPython resolves DNS before applying the socket timeout and applies that timeout separately to each resolved address](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/3.11/Lib/socket.py#L771-L805). The first `forge next` of the day can therefore stall well beyond three seconds before showing status; unversioned `forge upgrade` has the same problem. The previous subprocess had an overall timeout, while the replacement test only injects an immediate timeout. Bound the full lookup, including DNS and connection attempts.
Adds work: restore a wall-clock lookup deadline; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4.
